**v2.3.0 — Major reframing: Asset class framework & rules overhaul**

- Introduced A/B/C asset class system, replacing previous unified rule framework
- Simplified execution: rules reduced, asset layering/portfolio-level risk control prioritized
- "7 Red Lines" added as hard, non-override risk controls (e.g. max single/industry/AI exposure, VIX, drawdown)
- A-class (“platform core”) assets exempt from trailing stops; only allowed to sell for 3 fundamental reasons
- B-class maintains trailing stop, split entry modes; C-class uses DCA + rebalancing
- Override protocol made stricter: tiered permissions, limit to 2 per asset per quarter, mandatory record
- Detailed strategies split into reference files: A-shares, US stock, risk/override
- “No more new rules for 6-12 months”—focus on disciplined real-world execution and post-trade review

v1.5.2: Narrative-driven growth stock valuation classification. Uses self-historical PE center for stocks like TSLA where industry median rule fails. Additional requirements: reduced position, tighter stop, batched entry.
v1.5.1: Core position trailing stop (hold -20%, pullback -15%) replaces ladder take-profit. Avoid cutting winners in AI bull market. Ladder take-profit retained for new entries.
v1.5: dual-mode entry, portfolio risk control, override protocol, time-stop, dynamic target floor, position source classification

v2.1.0: Upgrade to v1.4 strategy - add A-share 3-condition system (elastic window, dynamic target, resilience downgrade, momentum dual-track, earnings rules), HK stock strategy, remove specific tickers from SKILL.md, add Q2 2026 strategy doc
